Title: Login with valid credentials (email id)
Preconditions: User qa.user1 is registered and active
Steps:
1. Open /login
2. Enter email
3. click confirm email and enter code
Expected result: User is redirected to job dashboard; user menu shows 'qa.user1';
Actual result: user signed up / logged in successfully with only email id

Title: Login fails with invalid email id
Steps:
1. Open /login
2. Enter invalid email
3. confirm email
Expected result: Error 'Invalid email' should've been shown; user stays on /sign-in;
Actual result: A code was sent to the entered invalid email id

Title: Login with both fields empty
Steps:
1. Open /sign-in
2. Click Login without entering data
Expected result: Inline messages 'Email is required' and 'Password is required' appear; no API call is sent
Actual result: Inline messages 'Email is required' and 'Password is required' appear; no API call is sent

Title: Upload file above size limit
Expected result: File is rejected with a size-limit message

Title: Upload unsupported file type
Expected result: File is rejected with 'Only PDF, DOC, DOCX allowed'; nothing is saved

Title: Search by keyword and location
Use case: UC-02 Job search by keyword and location
Preconditions: Seeded jobs exist: 'QA Engineer' in Bengaluru and Pune
Steps:
1. Open /jobs
2. Enter keyword and location
3. Click Search
Expected result: Every card shows a title containing 'QA Engineer' and location 'Bengaluru'; Pune job is absent; result count equals cards shown
